header: A full-width section for the recommended plan
subheader: Wider than a card, so there is room to explain why this plan fits.
bodytext: The rich text explains the plan in a paragraph or two: who it is for and what happens when they outgrow it. A card only has room for one sentence.
note: The note holds the conditions, such as tax, term and what counts as a seat.

features.title: The list flows into two to four columns
Read down each column, then across
A row can add a short detail
The price sits next to its period
Both buttons sit below the price
